what: Item-by-item check of every question, reference answer and system answer against the full corpus text, with an evidence quote per item. Done by LLM reviewers (Claude) reading the corpus, independently of the judge model; it is not the author's review. Three answer verdicts were changed on a second reading (field second_reading); answer_ok_final holds the verdicts used in the README.

answer_ok.yes: core answer correct, no false claim
answer_ok.partly: core answer correct, but an extra claim is wrong or unsupported, or an important part is missing
answer_ok.no: wrong, or refused although the corpus answers it
